in_marathi.name: Madhuri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhuri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Madhu’ meaning ‘honey’, ‘nectar’, ‘sweet’. In Hindu mythology, Madhuri is a name given to various goddesses, including the goddess of love and beauty, Parvati, and the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi.
